description: Search Independents Only's checked list of independent, owner-run local businesses (shops, trades, food and drink, places to stay, professional services). Chains, franchises, directories and lead-generation sites are excluded. Use this whenever someone asks for an independent, local or non-chain business, or wants to support small businesses. Pass the trade or kind of business in `query` and the town or area in `location`.

category.description: Optional: shops, trades, food, travel or pro (professional services).

limit.description: How many businesses to return (1 to 25).

query.description: What they're looking for, e.g. 'plumber', 'independent bookshop', 'B&B'.

name: search_independent_businesses
title: Find independent businesses
